Highest-confidence core. PSEN1, APP, SORL1, PSEN2 are corroborated by all four gene sources (Tier 1). A further 20 genes are supported by ≥3 independent sources (Tier 2): ABCA7, ACE, ACHE, ADAM10, APOE, APP, BACE1, CASP3, CD2AP, CLU, CR1, HFE, MPO, MS4A4A, NCSTN, PICALM, PLCG2, PRNP, PSEN1, PSEN2, SORL1, TNF, TREM2, UNC5C. Evidence types are kept separate: curated link 393 statistical/genetic 121 measured activity 19

Cross-source corroboration

Gene–pathway–drug mechanistic map

Entities are those actually retrieved from the sources (genes: spoke/rdkg/digcfdekg/prokn; drugs: prokn indications; pathways: GXA Reactome/GO), placed onto the established AD modules.

Findings by entity type

Genes (coding + non-coding). 4 sources → Tier-1 familial core (PSEN1/APP/SORL1/PSEN2); APOE carries the strongest statistical weight (10.2). 27 non-coding genes recovered — chiefly BACE1-regulating miRNAs (MIR29 family, MIR107).
Drugs. Kept separate by relationship: 268 indicated/investigated compounds (prokn/ChEMBL — anti-amyloid antibodies, secretase inhibitors, cholinergics); 2 "treats" edges in spoke-okn (Carbonic acid, Copper — a limitation); 56 contraindicated drugs (rdkg — antipsychotics, anticholinergics, opioids).
Altered activity + tissue (GXA, measured). Up-regulation of mitochondrial OXPHOS/translation, synaptic-vesicle, and proteasome programs in hippocampal formation, temporal cortex/gyrus/lobe, and posterior cingulate cortex (adj-p to 7.6×10⁻¹⁴).
Clinical features & biomarkers. rdkg: 70 HP hallmarks (neurofibrillary tangles, senile plaques, amyloid angiopathy, hippocampal atrophy, FDG-PET hypometabolism…). biomarkerkg: neuroinflammation panel (GFAP, TREM2, YKL-40, S100B, ICAM1, VCAM1, CCL2, TSPO) + VSNL1 in CSF/blood.
Flagged undercount — genetic variants. No AD-anchored variant-entity layer exists in these KGs; variant signal survives only at gene level via digcfdekg's GWAS-derived statistics. APOE-ε4 and APP/PSEN1/PSEN2 pathogenic mutations are represented by their genes, not as variant records.

Caveats & reproducibility

Variants and non-coding genes are undercounted; GXA is enrichment-level (not per-gene); prokn's gene layer is familial-only here; spoke-okn TREATS is near-empty; symbol-based matching may split aliases; oard-kg/pankgraph/ncipidkg/biobricks-aopwiki added no AD rows in scope. Every SPARQL query (verbatim) is preserved in AD_analysis_transcript.md; integration in integrate.py; figures in viz.py. Re-running against the listed KG versions reproduces the counts.
